_comment: B49 — turns a Ghostwire weapon treasure into a usable attack ability. Draw Steel has no per-weapon attack document: heroes get Melee/Ranged Free Strike (system abilities, category 'freeStrike') and kits supply the damage and distance bonuses. So a spawned ability is a free strike WITH THIS WEAPON: same shape as the system's free strike, distance from the weapon's range band, damage from the weapon's own RAW band, keywords that let kit bonuses apply normally.
_damageNote: The gear flag 'damage' is the weapon's RAW printed number, which Pass A lock A10 defines as the MIDDLE result. Low and high are derived with the same spread the system's own free strikes use (ranged 2/4/6 -> -2/+2 around the middle; melee 2/5/7 -> -3/+2). No characteristic is added: RAW prints weapon damage as the number itself, and kit bonus lines add on top by result.

Extreme._note: RAW does not define band distances in squares; Extreme collapses onto Long (the longest distance shipped in Ghostwire content) until it does.

damageTypes._comment: Pass A lock A9. Kinetic and AP are untyped; AP keeps its armor note on the gear itself.

_sfxNote: No sfx flag is stamped: the B40 keyword map already matches the generated name ('Fire Chatterbox' -> firearm rule, 'Strike with Monoblade' -> impact rule). A Director can still set a per-ability override on the sheet.
